revision: J: wheel-pod packaging and spring mechanism
status: Candidate mechanism, not fabrication or purchase release

bracket.motor_screw_head: Flush M3 countersunk replacement; stock bracket needs countersinking and fit verification

pivot.note: Internal collars avoid large heads beside the tire. Collar clamping/pin fit and bushing housing tolerances are unqualified. Use the 22.4 mm screw-clearance envelope, not only the 18 mm body.

spring.note: Sourcing target, not a selected spring. Cups rock on 3 mm transverse pins; guides telescope without passing through the trunnions. Shims lower the fixed upper fork to set module-specific preload.

stop.note: Dimensioned contact targets only. Adjustable compression stop, positive droop capture and wheel-drop sensor still need connected hardware.

mass.note: Solid CAD volumes for printed candidates plus separate allowances. Does not close fixed cap/cheek/frame connections or replace G's complete assembly ledger.
